content: Ventilator-associated Events (VAE) Print Minus Related Pages Available for In-Plan Adult Locations Only. See PedVAE and PNEU/VAP for in-plan surveillance for pediatric locations. See PedVAE for in-plan surveillance for neonatal locations. Not available for Inpatient Psychiatric Facilities (IPFs) VAE Calculator operates based upon the currently posted VAE protocol.
